interpretation.tier_a_definition: Fully verified matched control in the existing sensitivity audits; all contract matching dimensions must be documented against a confirmed event.
interpretation.scope: 437 beach/waterline segments actually resolved by montrose_shoreline; only the sampled frames, not intervening gaps or a whole morning.
interpretation.assessment_basis: Cross-check of committed structured three-frame vision, integrity records and exact burst timestamps. No independent pixel re-review; no new media retained.
interpretation.independence: One date and montrose_owner_cluster is one candidate episode. Different dates are distinct candidate mornings, not proof of statistical independence from serial weather correlation.
interpretation.public_trace: Useful corroborating evidence only when coverage and availability are known. No report found is not proof of no event.

web_review.coverage: Public search indexes and retrieved pages only; no complete or authenticated Facebook/Nextdoor date-filtered feed.
web_review.result: No retrieved result verified an actual event or independent known-effort non-event on any of the four target mornings. Many results were unrelated festivals, businesses, other Montrose locations or historical events. This is a retrieval result, not measured social silence.

sources.access: Public landing page with a few undated/relative-date snippets; full date-filtered neighborhood feed not retrieved

owner_public_trace_observation.source: User instruction in this task, 2026-09-30; prior September 28 context
owner_public_trace_observation.assessment: A real Jubilee normally leaving a public trace is a useful corroborating hypothesis. No numerical likelihood or 80% absence probability is adopted: coverage, reporting sensitivity, lag and scope have not been measured.

web_review.availability_rule: All retrospective searches in this audit are outcome review only, never pre-issuance forecast predictors.
web_review.unresolved: Facebook group posts and date-specific Nextdoor conversations remain unverified. Same-day September 30 reporting/indexing lag is additionally unresolved.
